title: Building Production-Grade AI for Asset & Wealth Management
paragraphs: AI Data Scientist with expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), machine learning, and AI applications for asset and wealth management. I build production-grade AI systems that automate investment research, financial document intelligence, and reporting workflows using LLMs, multi-agent architectures, and advanced data science techniques.

Skilled in Python, NLP, cloud-based AI deployment, and MLOps, I integrate financial data sources to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions for capital markets and wealth management — backed by a strong foundation in statistical modelling, time series analysis, and quantitative finance.

Sector focus: Financial Services, Asset/Wealth Management, Capital Markets, Investment Research, Generative AI, SaaS and Digital Products. I enjoy leading cross-functional work that turns AI prototypes into reliable, governed, measurable business value.
